basics.name: Andrew Scaccetti
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer & Homelab Engineer | Python • TypeScript • Docker • FastAPI • Linux
basics.summary: Full-stack developer and homelab engineer with 7 years of practical experience spanning web application development, Linux system administration, and automation. Builds performant backend services with FastAPI and Astro, containerizes distributed homelab workloads with Docker and Podman, and engineers event-driven automations using Python, MQTT, and OpenCV. Grounded in a strong hardware and troubleshooting foundation, with a focus on writing clean, maintainable code and self-hosting resilient infrastructure.
